permissions.project_administer.label: Administer project
permissions.project_administer.descripti: Change project settings — members, workflow, boards, fields, components and automation.
permissions.project_browse.label: View project
permissions.project_browse.description: Open the project and read its work items, boards, backlog and reports.
permissions.work_item_edit.label: Edit work items
permissions.work_item_edit.description: Create, update, assign and move work items, and transition them on the board.
permissions.work_item_archive.label: Archive work items
permissions.work_item_archive.descriptio: Archive a work item and restore it later. Affects that item only — its children stay.
permissions.work_item_delete.label: Delete work items
permissions.work_item_delete.description: Permanently delete a work item and everything beneath it. Cannot be undone.
permissions.work_item_triage.label: Triage requests
permissions.work_item_triage.description: Accept, decline, promote or snooze an item in Triage.
permissions.comment_add.label: Add comments
permissions.comment_add.description: Post comments on work items, and edit or delete your own.
permissions.comment_moderate.label: Moderate comments
permissions.comment_moderate.description: Edit and delete anyone's comments, not only your own.
permissions.attachment_create.label: Add attachments
permissions.attachment_create.descriptio: Upload files onto work items, and delete the ones you uploaded.
permissions.attachment_delete_any.label: Delete any attachment
permissions.attachment_delete_any.descri: Remove attachments uploaded by anyone, not only your own.
permissions.watcher_manage.label: Manage watchers
permissions.watcher_manage.description: Add and remove other people from a work item's watcher list. Anyone who can view a work item may watch it themselves.
permissions.approval_decide_any.label: Decide any approval
permissions.approval_decide_any.descript: Approve or request changes on an approval routed to someone else, not only one routed to you.
permissions.approval_view_any.label: See every approval
permissions.approval_view_any.descriptio: See all of the project's approval records, including other people's. Without it you see the approvals routed to you and the ones you decided.
permissions.plan_view_any.label: See every plan
permissions.plan_view_any.description: See all of the project's AI plans, including other people's. Without it you see the plans you started and the ones routed to you or decided by you.
permissions.run_view_any.label: See every agent run
permissions.run_view_any.description: See all of the project's agent runs, including other people's. Without it you see the runs you started.
permissions.instance_use.label: Use your own agents
permissions.instance_use.description: Create, wake, hibernate and delete your own agents on this project — machines charged per running minute. It never opens anyone else's.
permissions.page_view.label: Read pages
permissions.page_view.description: Open and read the project's pages.
permissions.page_edit.label: Edit pages
permissions.page_edit.description: Create pages, rename them and change what they say.
permissions.page_delete.label: Delete pages
permissions.page_delete.description: Permanently delete an archived page and its archived sub-pages.
permissions.public_request_comment.label: Comment on requests
permissions.public_request_comment.descr: Reply on a public request's thread. Public projects only.
permissions.public_request_submit.label: Submit requests
permissions.public_request_submit.descri: Send a bug report or feature request to the project's Requested features. Public projects only.
permissions.public_request_upvote.label: Upvote requests
permissions.public_request_upvote.descri: Vote on a public request to signal demand for it. Public projects only.
permissions.member_manage.label: Manage members
permissions.member_manage.description: Add and remove project members, and set their roles.
permissions.project_manage_access.label: Change project access
permissions.project_manage_access.descri: Set whether the project is public, open, limited or private.
permissions.board_configure.label: Configure boards
permissions.board_configure.description: Change board columns, swimlanes and WIP limits.
permissions.sprint_manage.label: Manage sprints
permissions.sprint_manage.description: Start and complete Sprints, and rank the backlog.
permissions.automation_manage.label: Manage automation rules
permissions.automation_manage.descriptio: Create, edit and enable the project’s automation and status-derivation rules.
permissions.workflow_manage.label: Manage the workflow
permissions.workflow_manage.description: Change the statuses a board column projects, and the transitions between them.
permissions.component_manage.label: Manage components
permissions.component_manage.description: Create, rename and delete the project’s components.
permissions.field_manage.label: Manage custom fields
permissions.field_manage.description: Create, edit and remove custom field definitions.
permissions.label_manage.label: Manage labels
permissions.label_manage.description: Create, rename and delete the project’s labels and tags.
permissions.estimation_manage.label: Manage estimation
permissions.report_view.label: View reports
permissions.report_view.description: Open the project’s reports — distribution, workload, resolution time, velocity and the roadmap.
permissions.saved_filter_manage.label: Manage saved filters
permissions.saved_filter_manage.descript: Create, edit, share and subscribe to the project’s saved filters.
permissions.saved_filter_manage_any.desc: See other people’s private filters, edit or delete any shared filter, and hand a shared filter to a new owner.
permissions.repository_manage.label: Manage repositories
permissions.repository_manage.descriptio: Add, remove, move and take over the project’s repositories.
permissions.repository_manage_access.des: Decide which team members may clone the project’s code.
permissions.integration_manage.label: Manage integrations
permissions.integration_manage.descripti: Connect and disconnect third-party services for this project — an error monitor, its stored credential, and which of its projects are bound.
permissions.import_run.label: Import work items
permissions.import_run.description: Bulk-create work items from Jira, Linear or Plane.
permissions.ai_configure.label: Configure AI planning
permissions.ai_configure.description: Set the planning cadence and whether explanations are drafted.
permissions.ai_plan.label: Run AI planning
permissions.ai_plan.description: Submit a planning job that spends the workspace’s AI credits and proposes plan changes.
permissions.ai_view_plan.label: Author AI plans
permissions.ai_view_plan.description: Add proposals to a generated plan and close it for review. Reading a plan needs only project access.
permissions.ai_decide_plan.label: Approve or decline AI plans
permissions.ai_decide_plan.description: Turn a plan’s proposals into real work items, or end the plan without creating any.
permissions.lesson_view.label: View the lesson library
permissions.lesson_view.description: Read what the project's AI planner learned from its own planning work.
permissions.lesson_manage.label: Change the lesson library
permissions.lesson_manage.description: Retire a lesson or add one — both change the standing instructions the planner is given.
permissions.lesson_reinforce.label: Record a lesson recurrence
permissions.lesson_reinforce.description: Note that a lesson's mistake happened again. It changes nothing the lesson says.

orgAdmin.security.lockedNoteBoth: This workspace requires two-factor authentication, and so does {org}. Turning off the organization’s requirement will leave this workspace’s own requirement in place.
orgAdmin.security.readOnlyNote: Only an owner or an admin of {tier} can change this.
orgAdmin.security.cardBodyWorkspace: Additionally require a second factor for everyone in this workspace. Your organization’s setting applies on top of this one and cannot be lowered here.

orgAdmin.delete.subscription: Your subscription won’t renew. The current period runs to its end; nothing more is charged.
orgAdmin.delete.billingKept: Billing records are kept for seven years, as the law requires.
orgAdmin.delete.dateSub: Until then {org} is read-only for everyone and you can cancel. There is no way to erase it sooner.
orgAdmin.delete.step2Sub: Everything is erased on {date}. Until then it is read-only, and you can cancel.

publicProjects.faqA1: Yes. This is a public project — anyone on the web can view it with no account, and it’s indexable by search engines. You only need to sign in to submit, upvote, or comment on requests.
publicProjects.faqQ2: How do I submit a request?
publicProjects.faqA2: Use the “Submit a request” button. You’ll be asked to sign in first (sign-in-to-act), then your bug or idea lands in the team’s Requested features and can appear on the public roadmap.
publicProjects.faqQ3: What’s hidden on the public view?

projectSquare.faqLede: The project square is a public, crawlable directory of every project teams have chosen to build in the open on Motir — their real roadmaps, boards, and sprints, free to read with no account.
projectSquare.faqA1: It's a public directory of project plans built on Motir. Every listed project is public by choice — you can read its roadmap, board, and work items with no sign-up.
projectSquare.faqQ2: Are these projects free to view?
projectSquare.faqA2: Yes. Every project in the square is fully public and free to read — no account, no paywall. You only need an account to create your own project.
projectSquare.faqA3: Trending surfaces projects with recent upvotes and activity, Popular ranks by lifetime upvotes, and New lists the most recently published — each a shareable, crawlable URL.
projectSquare.footerTagline: The AI-native way to plan, track, and ship — explore what teams are building in the open.
